name: Cameron House on Loch Lomond
insider_take: This baronial estate on the bonnie banks of Loch Lomond has been welcoming guests since 1986, but its story goes back centuries to when it served as the ancestral home of the Smollett family.
whats_special: Cameron House sits on 100 acres of pristine Scottish countryside with its own private marina on Britain's largest freshwater lake. The hotel features Scotland's only floating spa, The Carrick Spa, accessible by a stunning glass walkway over the loch. Golf enthusiasts can tee off on The Carrick championship course, designed by Doug Carrick, which offers breathtaking views across Loch Lomond to Ben Lomond.
pro_tip: Book a sunset cruise on the hotel's private yacht "Spirit of Loch Lomond" - you'll sail past the same islands that inspired Sir Walter Scott's "The Lady of the Lake" poem.
dont_miss: The Martin Wishart restaurant, helmed by Scotland's Michelin-starred chef, and a seaplane adventure over the Trossachs National Park. The hotel's location puts you just 30 minutes from Glasgow yet feels worlds away in the heart of Rob Roy country.
pros: Stunning lakeside location on famous Loch Lomond with breathtaking views
World-class spa and wellness facilities for ultimate relaxation
Championship golf course and extensive outdoor activities
Luxury accommodations with Scottish heritage charm and modern amenities
cons: Remote location requires travel time to reach major cities
Weather-dependent outdoor activities in Scottish climate
